description: Dar and Tao encounter new powers and rival peoples across the Territories as conflicts with Zad, Voden, Iara and other supernatural forces repeatedly upset the balance between humans and nature.

s02e01.description: Two new races enter the Territories and violence erupts as they challenge Zad and the Terrons for supremacy, drawing Dar and Tao into the struggle.

s02e02.description: Dar and Tao search for missing men on an island inhabited by the serpent demon Iara and a colony of mysterious women.

s02e03.description: Dar protects the seer Olwen from Arina and the Terrons, who want to exploit her visions for their own purposes.

s02e04.description: Arina’s dead lover returns from beyond the grave and tries to take her with him to the World Beneath the World.

s02e05.description: Tao returns to Xinca and finds his people driven away by an evil priest while Arina leads the Nords against the Terrons.

s02e06.description: The determined spirit of a dying tiger helps Tao recognize a new purpose in his life.

s02e07.description: Dar and Tao become involved in a bitter family dispute and discover that words may succeed where force cannot.

s02e08.description: The demon Iara stalks Dar and plots to claim the Beastmaster for herself.

s02e09.description: A lion cub seeks Dar’s help to save its mother, leading the Beastmaster into a fight against the despot Arkon and his hold over a village.

s02e10.description: Voden threatens the animals of the forest to lure Dar into danger, while a rare Tasmanian tiger is targeted by a vengeful hunter.

s02e11.description: Dar tries to restore nature’s balance when a shaman uses starving crocodiles and the villagers’ fear to strengthen his power.

s02e12.description: Dar is drawn into another crisis of ecological imbalance while Tao confronts a personal connection to the threatened community.

s02e13.description: Dar promises to reunite Huna with the child who was raised by wolves and is now being hunted by a murderous enemy.

s02e14.description: Dar helps Lyca escape the oppressive rule of the lion people.

s02e15.description: Dar aids centaur archers Sagitto and Radia after they are driven from the safety of their homeland.

s02e16.description: Anubis is released from a rock prison and seeks to reclaim power over the four elements of nature.

s02e17.description: Iara strips Dar of his ability to communicate with animals, throwing the natural world out of balance.

s02e18.description: Dar must correct an imbalance in nature caused by an avenging angel.

s02e19.description: The lost Eiron city of Mydoro holds powers capable of either healing the world or devastating it.

s02e20.description: Dar infiltrates Chalka to free sacred tigers and end Queen Lyoka’s deadly reign.

s02e21.description: Arina is pursued by the Apparition for her unborn child and by Voden for her mare’s foal.

s02e22.description: Zad moves to crush Voden and forces elephants to batter down the walls of Xinca.
